about: 조회 조건 코드도움이 id 로 거르는지 — 고르면 남은 줄이 전부 그 거래처·창고·품목이다(5·9회차). node qa/shot.mjs qa/flows/cond-by-id.json 소계·합계 줄은 뺀다.

shots.name: 준비 — 미출하현황에 걸릴 출하지시서 한 장(QA-CUST · QA창고 · QA-PROD)
steps: js:(async () => { const H = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const g = async (u) => (await fetch('/api' + u, { headers: H })).json(); const [ps, ws, its] = await Promise.all([g('/partners'), g('/warehouses'), g('/items')]); const p = ps.find((x) => x.code === 'QA-CUST'), w = ws.find((x) => x.name === 'QA창고'), it = its.find((x) => x.code === 'QA-PROD'); const d = new Date(Date.now() - new Date().getTimezoneOffset() * 6e4).toISOString().slice(0, 10); const r = await (await fetch('/api/shipment-orders', { method: 'POST', headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ orderDate: d, partnerId: p.id, warehouseId: w.id, lines: [{ itemId: it.id, quantity: 1 }] }) })).json(); sessionStorage.setItem('cbiSo', String(r.id)); return true })()

finally: js:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const id = sessionStorage.getItem('cbiSo'); if (id) await fetch('/api/shipment-orders/' + id, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H }); return true })()
